title: Dead or Alive
native_title: デッド・オア・アライブ
overview:
Strike! Throw! Lock! In this fierce clash, is your fate life? Or death!?

Dead or Alive is a 3D fighting game from Tecmo, brought home from the arcade. Choose from a cast of tournament fighters including the ninja Hayabusa and Kasumi, the pro wrestler Tina, the Muay Thai kickboxer Zack, the jeet kune do fighter Jann-Lee and the Taikyoku-ken prodigy Lei-Fang. Punch, kick and throw your way through the bouts, and use holds to catch an incoming attack and turn it against your opponent. Watch the edges of the ring: the Danger Zone is rigged with explosives that blast anyone knocked into it.

- One or two players
- Tournament and training modes
- Memory backup

打つ！投げる！極める！
せめぎ合うこの熾烈な戦いに君の運命は、生か？死か!?
